claim: For the one-parameter three-round two-way LOCC protocol for minimum-error discrimination of the equiprobable double-trine ensemble introduced by Chitambar and Hsieh, with Alice's first-round measurement strength \(p\in[0,1]\), the total error probability is exactly \[E(p)=1-\frac12\left(Q(p)+\sqrt{S(p)}\right),\]where \[Q(p)=\frac{8+2\sqrt3+(\sqrt3-2)p}{12}\]and \[S(p)=\frac{20+8\sqrt3+(4+8\sqrt3)p-(3+4\sqrt3)p^2}{48}.\]This protocol family has a unique global minimizer \[p_*=\frac{45-8\sqrt3}{39}=0.798553680498\ldots,\]with exact minimum error \[E_*=\frac{63-32\sqrt3}{117}=0.0647382406649\ldots.\]The endpoint \(p=1\) is the optimal one-way protocol with error \(E_{\to}=1/2-\sqrt3/4\), so the explicit feedback protocol's exact advantage is \[E_{\to}-E_*=\frac{11\sqrt3-18}{468}>0.\]The claim optimizes only this published one-parameter adaptive protocol family; it does not claim the globally optimal finite-round or unrestricted LOCC error.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; high-precision evaluation and a dense grid are supplementary checks
integrity.novelty_scope: Closed-form optimizer, minimum error, and strict one-way gap for the explicit adaptive one-parameter protocol whose source reports only a numerical minimum.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The double-trine ensemble, adaptive protocol, branch probabilities, Helstrom formula, one-way optimum, and qualitative two-way advantage are credited to Chitambar and Hsieh.

scientific_limitations: The result optimizes only the published one-parameter three-round adaptive LOCC protocol, not all finite-round or unrestricted LOCC protocols.
The derivation assumes the equiprobable double-trine ensemble and the source's exact measurement architecture.

The direct 2013 Physical Review paper uses physics subject conventions rather than MSC; the same authors' 2014 mathematical treatment of this discrimination program is indexed primarily under MSC 81P15.
An equivalent exact simplification may exist in unindexed literature or under a different measurement-strength parametrization.
title: Exact optimum of the adaptive double-trine discrimination protocol
